problem: Actual Git porcelain reports untracked nested repositories and ignored directory records with a trailing slash. A canonical Finder publication key must name the directory without that marker. The old snapshot builder retained it, and the strict publication validator rejected the update.
implementation: Normalize exactly one trailing marker only for valid relative untracked/ignored status paths at the snapshot boundary. Original status records, literal UTF-8 identity and strict publication authority validation remain unchanged.

Own macOS GetURL Apple events for the Settings-only SwiftUI app and feed the existing command router. Repeated valid URLs are preserved; current-owner lifetime and deferred-retirement fences prevent duplicate or revived handlers.
Fit the shared action-error window to wrapped content; retain selectable full diagnostics inside a bounded scroll area and the trailing default OK/close callback.

core.scope: Three new directory-publication methods plus retained Finder publication/status-policy methods; real Git nested/ignored marker reproduction, canonical badge publication, byte identities, unchanged HEAD/index, unsafe-path refusal and policy fences.
